Hero.overline: A studio for salons, spas & beauty brands
Hero.headline: Marketing Agency Melbourne
Hero.sub: We work with salons, spas, nail studios, aesthetics clinics, and beauty brands. The kind of marketing that actually moves the calendar: clear positioning, a site and booking flow people can use, and social plus paid that gets measured on the appointments that show up.
Hero.subMobile: Websites, social, and ads for salons, spas, and beauty brands — measured on real appointments, not likes.
Hero.quote: Local SEO and Google Ads, measured on bookings.

Philosophy.lead: Posting for the sake of posting does not fill columns. We align every channel with how people actually book beauty services: search, social proof, clear service pages, and follow-up that turns one-time visits into regulars.
Philosophy.card01Body: Reels, carousels, and captions tied to services you sell, seasonal promos, and local discovery—so the feed supports bookings, not just reach.
Philosophy.card02Body: Fast, mobile-first sites with clear menus, pricing cues, and one obvious path to book or message—fewer drop-offs before someone picks a time.
Philosophy.imageAlt: Skincare treatment—hands applying product in soft light

Solutions.title: Web design, SEO, branding & lead generation.
Solutions.card01Body: We connect your stack—Square, GlossGenius, Acuity, or others—so confirmations, reminders, and win-back messages reduce no-shows and protect artist time.
Solutions.bookingImageAlt: Smartphone on a table—booking and reminders context
Solutions.card02Body: New builds or refreshes: service menus, team bios, galleries, offers, and SEO-friendly copy—updated when you launch collections or promos.
Solutions.card03Body: Meta and TikTok campaigns plus always-on organic content, aimed at your radius, your ideal client, and the services you want to grow.

Process.metaDescription: How Olive Marketing works with beauty and wellness brands — from discovery to launch and beyond.
Process.heading: From first call to full launch.
Process.lead: Every engagement follows a clear, repeatable process so you always know what's happening, what's next, and how we measure success.
Process.step01Body: We listen first. In a 30-minute call we learn about your business, your current marketing, what's working, what isn't, and where you want to grow. No pitch deck — just honest questions.
Process.step02Body: We review your website, booking flow, social profiles, ad accounts, and competitors. You get a written strategy brief with priorities, quick wins, and a 90-day roadmap — before we write a single line of copy.
Process.step03Body: We send a clear proposal: deliverables, timeline, and pricing. No hidden fees, no lock-in contracts. You approve, we kick off.
Process.step04Body: Our team gets to work — website builds, ad creative, content calendars, booking integrations, and SEO foundations. You review everything in shared docs and approve before anything goes live.
Process.step05Body: We go live, monitor performance daily, and optimise weekly. Ads get tested, content gets scheduled, and your booking flow gets refined based on real data — not guesses.
Process.step06Body: Monthly reports tied to what matters: inquiries, bookings, and revenue — not vanity metrics. We meet regularly to review, adjust, and plan the next push.
Process.ctaBody: Tell us about your business and we'll walk you through how the process looks for your specific situation.
